staff_read_day_entries.name: staff_read_day_entries
staff_read_day_entries.using:
(is_staff(auth.uid()) OR (party_id IN ( SELECT parties.id
   FROM parties
  WHERE (parties.user_id = auth.uid()))))

owner_read_uptime.name: owner_read_uptime
owner_read_uptime.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_roles
  WHERE ((user_roles.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (user_roles.role = 'owner'::app_role))))
